basis: Isolated postaxial polydactyly is a congenital skeletal malformation.
Oral and digital malformations define it; intellectual disability 8/8 and hearing impairment 2/3. Cap excludes cardiac and ocular defects reported in 1/3.
OFD1-associated rod-cone retinal degeneration; no evidence here of systemic OFD1 syndrome manifestations.
Defined as disease of the mouth, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Smooth muscle malignancy arising in the breast; breast has no axis. Histology alone does not establish skeletal muscle or infectious involvement.
Dentin and dental root abnormalities cause tooth disease and loss; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Benign neoplasm confined to breast tissue, which has no axis.
Skeletal abnormalities, microtia 8/8 and immune deficiency with infections 5/7; neutropenia 5/6 supports blood involvement. Cap omits intellectual disability reported in 2/2.
Late-onset inherited retinal degeneration; no systemic organ involvement established.
Fatal skeletal myofibrillar myopathy; respiratory insufficiency 8/8 reflects respiratory muscle dysfunction rather than intrinsic lung damage.
Neoplasm originates in the floor of the mouth, within the gastrointestinal axis.
Named neurodevelopmental, ear and skeletal abnormalities; high myopia/amblyopia reported in 1/1. Raynaud alone lacks damage; thyroiditis and esophagitis are separate diagnoses.
Defined by disrupted steroid metabolism; other organ damage is not shared across this umbrella.
Disease of small peripheral nerve fibers; autonomic symptoms alone do not establish damage to additional organs.
Inherited iron metabolism disorder with brain iron accumulation, cerebellar degeneration and peripheral neuropathy.
Degenerative visceral smooth muscle disease classified as an intestinal disorder; visceral muscle is not skeletal muscle.
Endometriosis localized to the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Pontocerebellar maldevelopment and degeneration; visual impairment 30/32 is predominantly cerebral. Dysphagia reflects neurologic dysfunction, without intrinsic GI damage.
Brain/digital malformations; microphthalmia 80-99% and endocrine hypoplasia 30-79%. Cap omits oral/anorectal and cardiac defects (30-79%); renal defects 5-29%.
Persistent kidney damage and impaired renal function define CKD; anemia, mineral disorders and cardiovascular diseases are separately diagnosed or stage-dependent.
Congenital spinal dysraphism defined by a skin lesion connected to the spinal cord through a fibroneural stalk.
Middle ear ossicular chain disruption causes conductive hearing loss; specialized ear bones belong to the otologic axis.
Predominantly reproductive and pelvic disease; bowel, urinary tract and other extrapelvic involvement do not meet the threshold across the umbrella.
Congenital limb contractures and scoliosis define it. Definition specifies normal intelligence and no primary neurologic disease; conflicting HPO entries lack frequencies.
Inherited erythrocyte pyruvate metabolism abnormality with increased ATP, reduced 2,3-DPG and reported polycythemia.
